**Finding: COMPLIANT (no redline proposed).**

The AUDIT rule constrains audits *of our client*. Across the Agreement and its Attachments, every audit/inspection/verification right is exercisable **by IBM (and, in Attachment 6, by IBM or Microsoft) against MSL** — Section 7.0 process audits, Attachment 6 §4.0 software-location monitoring/inspection/audit, Attachment 6 §4 books-and-records audits (at MSL's facilities, 45 days' notice, independent CPA, cost on IBM unless material discrepancies), consigned-inventory and tooling inspections, and acceptance/source inspection. Section 16.14 is a mutual retention obligation only and grants no examination right over IBM.

MSL has no right to audit, inspect or remotely access IBM's records, facilities or systems, so there is no Customer-side audit exposure to cap with frequency, notice, cost or system-access limits. The position sits better than the preferred checklist, and redlining the IBM-favourable audit clauses would only weaken us.
